entities.name: Northrop C-19 Alpha
entities.label: Idea
entities.summary: The Northrop C-19 Alpha was a series of three aircraft purchased from Northrop by the US Army Air Corps in 1931. They were slightly modified versions of the civil Northrop Alpha Type 2.
